name: Agent Meters
author: Chris Rueber
description: One Omarchy bar widget for every AI agent you actually use: OpenRouter, OpenCode, Grok, Codex and Claude, each with its own mark and limit meters. Agents you have no subscription or key for stay out of the bar.

barWidget.description: Marks and limit meters for the AI agents on this machine; only the ones you actually use are shown.

schema.label: Bar shows
schema.description: bars: each mark with one meter per limit window; text: short percentages instead of meters; icon: just the marks.

schema.label: Show Claude when signed in
schema.description: Claude appears only when Claude Code has a plan or usage on this machine.

schema.label: Show OpenRouter when keyed
schema.description: OpenRouter appears when a key is found in OPENROUTER_API_KEY or the OpenCode credential store.

schema.label: Show Codex when signed in
schema.description: Codex appears only when Codex CLI has a plan with limits on this machine.

schema.label: Agent order
schema.description: Internally managed by the panel drag handle: comma-separated agent ids in bar order. Empty uses OpenRouter, OpenCode, Grok, Codex, Claude.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often to read every agent. Five minutes is the default; a disk cache avoids extra reads on shell restart.

schema.label: Warning threshold (%)
schema.description: Meters turn the warning colour at this percentage.

schema.label: Critical threshold (%)
schema.description: Meters turn the urgent colour at this percentage.

schema.label: Warning colour
schema.description: Hex colour; empty keeps the theme foreground.

schema.label: Critical colour
schema.description: Hex colour; empty uses the theme's urgent colour.

schema.label: Node executable
schema.description: Optional. Path to node for the collector; empty finds node in your login shell PATH.

schema.label: OpenCode auth file
schema.description: Optional. OpenCode 1 credential file with the OpenRouter key; empty uses ~/.local/share/opencode/auth.json and then `opencode auth export`. OPENROUTER_API_KEY overrides this.

schema.label: Grok home
schema.description: Optional. Grok logs and session ledgers; empty uses $GROK_HOME or ~/.grok.

schema.label: Grok Bot cache directory
schema.description: Optional. Grok Bot's sand-client-persistence directory; empty uses ~/.config/Grok Bot/sand-client-persistence.

schema.label: opencode executable
schema.description: Optional. Path to the opencode binary; empty finds opencode in your login shell PATH.

schema.label: Codex usage collector
schema.description: Optional. Path to `omarchy-agent-usage-codex`; empty uses the command on your login-shell PATH, then the saved usage record.

schema.label: Show local activity in the popup
schema.description: Adds today's prompts and tokens per agent, read from the local records the agents already keep.

schema.label: Right-click command
schema.description: Optional shell command; empty opens this plugin's page.
